detail_text: Specifically, 1. a. During the manufacturing of, lot number_, manufacturing employees reported black specks had been found in tablets, and metal shaving were found on the upper gear shield ofyour tablet press after the hopper was emptied. It was determined by the quality assurance team the completed product was contaminated, as was the remaining un-pressed powder which was removed from the hopper, and all pressed tablets and powder were disposed of. This investigation found an adjustment bolt for the feed plate was misaligned, and when tightened it pulled the upper gear shield against the turret, which allowed rubbing and caused the metal shavings. However, the investigation does not indicate whether or not any previous batches ofproduct manufactured on this equipment may have been affected by this same mechanical problem. b. The same batch production record for, lot number indicates grams ofpowder had been thrown away from cleanup, but does not indicate any tables were manufactured. However, the investigation report for this incident, dated April 3, 2008, indicates"All pressed tables and remaining powder was disposed of" c. The investigation report for this same incident, dated April 3, 2008, indicates the incident occurred on March 27th, yet it was not reported to Quality Control until March 3t, 2008. There is no documentation on the batch record indicating Quality Control was notified and made any decision about this product prior to March 3tst. 2. During the manufacturing of lot number_, the batch production records indicated a "loud pop then on one ofthe top punches had metal shavings" and "_kg oftablets & powder thrown away that was done around the time the metal shavings was found." The batch production record also indicated employees "found a piece ofduct tape in shoot" and grams ofpowder & tablets disposed ofin strainer & container." There was no evidence ofany investigation being conducted related to these incidents, and no evidence any investigation was conducted to determine whether or not any previous batches ofproduct manufactured on this equipment may have been affected by this piece ofequipment.
detail_text_ko: 구체적으로, 1. a. 로트 번호 _ 의 제조 중, 제조 직원들은 정제에서 검은 반점이 발견되었다고 보고했고, 호퍼를 비운 뒤 정제기의 상부 기어 보호대에서 금속 부스러기(metal shaving)가 발견되었다고 보고했다. 품질 보증 팀은 완성된 제품이 오염되었고 호퍼에서 꺼낸 아직 타정되지 않은 잔여 분말도 오염되었다고 판단했으며, 타정된 모든 정제와 분말은 폐기되었다. 이 조사에서 급송판(feed plate)의 조정 볼트가 어긋나 있었고, 조여지면 상부 기어 보호대를 터릿(turret) 쪽으로 당겨 마찰이 생겨 금속 부스러기가 발생한 것으로 확인되었다. 그러나 조사에는 이 설비에서 제조한 이전 제품 배치가 같은 기계적 문제의 영향을 받았을 수 있는지 여부가 기재되어 있지 않다. b. 로트 번호 _ 의 동일한 배치 생산 기록서에는 세척으로 인해 분말 grams 이 버려졌다고 되어 있으나 어떤 정제가 제조되었다는 기록은 없다. 그러나 April 3, 2008자 이 사건의 조사 보고서에는 "All pressed tables and remaining powder was disposed of"라고 되어 있다. c. April 3, 2008자 동일 사건의 조사 보고서에는 사건이 March 27th에 발생했다고 되어 있으나, March 3t, 2008이 되어서야 품질 관리 부서에 보고되었다. March 3tst 이전에 품질 관리 부서에 통보되었고 이 제품에 대해 어떤 결정을 내렸음을 보여 주는 문서가 배치 기록서에 없다. 2. 로트 번호 _ 의 제조 중, 배치 생산 기록서에는 "loud pop then on one ofthe top punches had metal shavings"와 "_kg oftablets & powder thrown away that was done around the time the metal shavings was found."라고 기재되어 있었다. 배치 생산 기록서에는 또한 직원들이 "found a piece ofduct tape in shoot"하였고 grams ofpowder & tablets disposed ofin strainer & container.라고 기재되어 있었다. 이러한 사건과 관련하여 조사가 수행되었다는 증거가 없으며, 이 설비에서 제조한 이전 제품 배치가 이 설비의 문제로 영향을 받았을 수 있는지 판단하기 위한 조사가 수행되었다는 증거도 없다.
